dialogues.title: Ordering coffee
dialogues.context: Bir kafeye giriyorsun ve sipariş veriyorsun. Sıra sende, arkanda bekleyenler var — kısa ve net konuş.

lines.en: Hi there! What can I get for you?
alternatives: Hi! What can I get you?
Hey there, what would you like?

lines.en: Can I get a medium latte, please?
Sure. Anything else?
alternatives: Of course. Anything else for you?

lines.en: That's it, thanks.
Is that for here or to go?
To go, please.
That's four fifty. Cash or card?
lines.tr: Dört elli tutuyor. Nakit mi kart mı?
alternatives: Four fifty, please. Cash or card?

lines.en: Card, please.
Can I get a name for the cup?
lines.tr: Bardağa yazmak için adınızı alabilir miyim?

lines.en: It's Baris. B-A-R-I-S.
Got it. It'll be ready at the end of the counter.
alternatives: Perfect. We'll call you at the other end.

lines.en: Great, thanks a lot.

dialogues.title: Dinner for two
dialogues.context: Rezervasyonsuz bir restorana gittin. Masa bulup menüyü inceleyip sipariş vereceksin.

lines.en: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?
alternatives: Evening! Do you have a booking?

lines.en: No, we don't. Table for two, please.
lines.tr: Hayır, yok. İki kişilik masa, lütfen.
alternatives: We don't, sorry. Do you have a table for two?

lines.en: No problem. Right this way.
Here are the menus. Can I get you anything to drink?
lines.tr: Buyurun menüler. İçecek bir şey alır mısınız?
alternatives: Menus for you. Something to drink to start?

lines.en: Could we get some water, please? Tap is fine.
lines.tr: Biraz su alabilir miyiz? Musluk suyu olur.
alternatives: Some tap water would be great.

lines.en: Of course. Are you ready to order?
We're still deciding. What do you recommend?
lines.tr: Hâlâ karar veriyoruz. Ne tavsiye edersiniz?
alternatives: Give us a minute — what's good here?

lines.en: The lamb is very popular tonight.
What's in it?
Slow-cooked lamb with potatoes and a yogurt sauce.
lines.tr: Ağır ateşte pişmiş kuzu, patates ve yoğurtlu sos.
alternatives: Lamb, potatoes, and a yogurt sauce on the side.

lines.en: I'll have that, but without onions, please.
lines.tr: Ondan alayım ama soğansız olsun, lütfen.
alternatives: Sounds good — can I have it without onions?

lines.en: Absolutely. I'll put that in for you.
alternatives: No problem at all. I'll get that started.

dialogues.title: Something's wrong with the order
dialogues.context: Yanlış yemek geldi ve garsonu çağırdın. Sakin ama net olmalısın — sonunda da hesabı isteyeceksin.

lines.en: How is everything?
Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered.
alternatives: Sorry, I think this is the wrong dish.

lines.en: Oh, I'm so sorry. What did you order?
lines.tr: Ah, çok özür dilerim. Ne sipariş etmiştiniz?
alternatives: My apologies — what was your order?

lines.en: I asked for the soup, not the salad.
That was my fault. I'll fix it right away.
alternatives: Completely my mistake — I'll sort it out now.

lines.en: No worries. Could you heat this up a bit for my friend?
lines.tr: Önemli değil. Arkadaşımınkini biraz ısıtabilir misiniz?
alternatives: It's fine, really. Could you warm his up though?

lines.en: Of course. Sorry to keep you waiting.
alternatives: Right away. Sorry about the wait.

lines.en: It's fine, really.
Here you go. Again, I do apologize.
Thank you. Could we get the check, please?
alternatives: Thanks. Can we have the bill when you get a chance?

lines.en: Certainly. I've taken the salad off the bill.
alternatives: Of course — and the salad's on us.

lines.en: That's very kind of you, thank you.
alternatives: You didn't have to do that — I really appreciate it.
